verses.text: He praises God for delivering him, and exhorts others to praise him, ver.
Recollects his former security, and his prayer when in trouble, ver.
And stirs himself up to thankfulness, ver.
A Psalm and song, at the dedication of the house of David.
Song - A psalm to be sung with the voice to an instrument.
David - At the dedication of David's house, which was built, 2 Sam. v, 11, and doubtless was dedicated, as God had commanded.
Cometh - Speedily and in due season.
Mountain - My kingdom: kingdoms are usually called mountains in prophetical writings.
Profit - What wilt thou gain by it?
The dust - Shall they that are dead celebrate thy goodness in the land of the living?
Or, shall my dust praise thee?
Sackcloth - Given me occasion to put off that sackcloth, which they used to wear in times of mourning, Esth iv, 1 chap. xxxv, 13 Isaiah xxxii, 11 Joel i, 13.
Girded - With joy, as with a garment, surrounding me on every side.
